newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH JANUARY CPI UP 2.9 PCT -STATOFFICE INFOLINE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH JANUARY CPI UP 2.9 PCT -STATOFFICE INFOLINE.

text.p: Polish consumer prices rose 2.9 percent in January against a 1.3 percent rise in December, according to preliminary Central Statistical Office (GUS) figures given over its telephone information line.
The recorded telephone information service did not give any year-on-year inflation figures. In December year-on-year inflation was 18.5 percent.
GUS spokesman Wieslaw Lagodzinksi declined to confirm the telephone report and said that official data on January's CPI would be available later today.
